description: Jev replay of routine LBT observing-assistant decisions (OSU partner queue, nights 2026 Sep 9-15). Zero-label AnyJev L0 choices over code-built menus, compared with what was decided on the nights. Aggregate numbers only.

logging.label: log an observation
logging.reference: Status the assistant recorded for the target: its mark_observed call arguments (one case) or, for the rest, its night-note / plan record of the night outcome after reading the same observer message or night log. One case per (message, target named in it).
logging.code_baseline: keyword rule on the line that names the target (skip words, then done words, then partial words; nothing said = skipped)

dropped.what: chat message, night Sep 12: one PEPSI target
dropped.why: assistant recorded its status as still to be confirmed

dropped.what: chat message, night Sep 12: one program's targets
dropped.why: the assistant's record names the program, not which targets
the observer status arrived as an image; the text names no target
the source log was a PDF read outside the transcript text; no observer text to replay
the observer status arrived as screenshots; no text message and no logging record

weather.label: weather call
weather.reference: What happened next with the dome: observe = open or opened next with no closure in between; wait = closed (or closed now) and reopened later that night; close = closed for the rest of the night. Read from set_conditions calls, night notes and the OSURC night logs. Sky class: the sky value of the assistant's set_conditions call in the same request.
weather.code_baseline: rule on the lbt_tools weather limits: bad now if RH >= 90 %, precipitation in the NWS row or CSC cloud >= 70 %; then wait if a later hour before twilight has RH < 85 %, no precipitation and cloud <= 30 %, else close; sky class from the CSC cloud of the hour

dropped.why: the message itself states the decision (instrument and program for a cloudy sky)
duplicate of the previous request, same state, no new data
the message itself states the decision (opening now)
instrument choice question, no dome decision
ambiguous: closed, humidity back down, 'reopening possible', opened 15 min later
duplicate of the previous request during opening
instrument choice question, no dome decision
duplicate of the previous request (a limit reminder)
two requests in the same minute: one instrument question, one duplicate seeing check

next.label: next queue target
next.reference: The target the telescope went to next (science, or a preset without science for two cases), from the night notes, the observed log, the plans and the OSURC logs quoted in the transcripts.
next.code_baseline: lbt_tools planner: greedy_schedule from the decision time on the configured instrument, first target

dropped.why: no record of which target followed; the observer's updates were screenshots and the session went quiet until 23:08
engineering tests, not a queue target

slit.label: slit position angle
slit.reference: Acquisition-script PA with the lowest mean blue (0.35-0.45 um) slit loss over the visit, computed with lbt_tools.optics.mods_slit_check (the mods_slit_losses tool); the Jev sees the same losses.
slit.code_baseline: argmin of the computed loss (the reference itself, 100 % by construction)
